names identity explicitly as carrying no timestamp bounds and hence no baseline-diff

is a curl sweep of twelve paths on web-1 that returned all 404s; nothing in it mutates a
realm role, an authorized_hosts list, or an enabled flag, so the identity records observed
are identical to what they would be with no activity. An empty projection therefore
represents a zero delta correctly, and it also avoids inventing concrete role/host values
the story never grounds.
